commits_data.title: More wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool conversions
commits_data.message:
More wmem_packet_scope -> pinfo->pool conversions

Most of these needed packet_info* passed in from a layer or two above the call to wmem_packet_scope().
Split between passing in packet_info* (majority) or wmem_allocator* to allocate the memory needed.

commits_data.title: Add wmem_array_get_allocator
commits_data.message:
Add wmem_array_get_allocator

Expose the memory allocator used by the array so it can be used to allocate the elements within in and not need a "duplicate" source of where the memory allocation should come from
